name: Ray Tracing Implicit Surfaces
definition: Ray tracing an implicit surface involves finding the intersection of a viewing ray with a surface defined by a function f(x,y,z) = 0. It is formulated as a root-finding problem where the parametric ray equation is substituted into the implicit function to create a unidimensional function f_t(t), which is then solved for the smallest t > 0.
summary: Ray tracing implicit surfaces renders surfaces defined by filter functions by solving for ray intersections without proxy meshes, supporting secondary rays and acceleration structures.
